subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “When Ruby cleaned her father's desk, she found an old movie ticket.”?
options: They were used many years ago to protect the wood.
It sits near the door and plays songs from many years ago.
The date on it was twenty years ago.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「They were used many years ago to protect the wood.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some were from years ago.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It sits near the door and plays songs from many years ago.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The date on it was twenty years ago.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The date on it was twenty years ago.」，答案為「The date on it was twenty years ago.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The date on it was twenty years ago.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
